Minimum amounts ​ Contribution Minimum Created for Bounty $20 USD Resolving a GitHub issue Tip $1 USD Thanking a contributor on an issue or pull request Only code owners can create bounties, and only for issues in their own repositories. More than one code owner may create a bounty for the same issue; each person is responsible only for the bounty they created. When a bounty is paid ​ Creating or claiming a bounty does not create an automatic payment. A developer submits a pull request, then each bounty creator reviews whether it meets the requirements described in the issue. If it does, that creator arranges payment for their own bounty.
